paragraphs: With {years}+ years in the software industry, I specialize in distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and clean architecture. I work hands-on in both Go and C#/.NET, with deep experience in DDD, CQRS, and Event Sourcing.
For the past two and a half years I have worked hands-on with AI-assisted development, mostly with context engineering: structuring sessions and prompts so the tools produce code worth keeping.
I run Devbit Consulting AB from Vänersborg, Sweden.
